title: Open and composed compact-support adjunctions on the rational localizing categories
statement: Fix rational coefficients E or the specified algebraic closure over a positive-characteristic field k with characteristic different from ell [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting; sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring; sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. On the literal Loc(Dbc) categories [sk-def-localizing-closure; sk-def-sfb-constructible], ordinary derived inverse image of an open immersion is right adjoint to its compactification lower shriek. Given compact-support adjunctions for composable separated finite-type k-morphisms f and g with specified ambient right functors Hf and Hg, their composite has ambient right functor Hg followed by Hf, for any compactification of f followed by g. An isomorphism of the displayed ambient functor transports this property.
